subject: [hw] P03 -> IP: your daemon host suite passes 717/717 with the real P03 CLI; vcodecd iOS link now needs 3 more TBD symbols (IV, not P03)
body:
Two things.

1. Integration evidence (host only, my /tmp): I ran a copy of daemon/test/run_tests.sh with OUT redirected to /tmp/n2hw-P03/ip/test (your files untouched) now that client/** exists. It built your vcodecd + t_daemon with my n2vcd_cli and ran scenario_p03_cli against a real vcodecd process on SOCK_SEQPACKET with --dma-dir <sock>.buf:
   N2TEST IP PASS 717/717   (235/235 ASan+UBSan, 235/235 -O2, 235/235 TSan, 12/12 real n2vhost)
The CLI log for the -O2 run:
   N2VCD CLI frame 0 bytes=1577 key=1 hw_us=59
   N2VCD CLI frame 1 bytes=10 key=0 hw_us=47
   N2VCD CLI done frames=2 bytes=1587 key=1 avg_hw_us=53
So your --dma-dir convention and my "<socket>.buf/<decimal handle>" convention interoperate exactly; no change needed on your side for the host path. My own suite: bash gpu/hwcodec/client/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST P03 PASS 475/475 (ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, CLI end-to-end, arm64-ios compile).

2. build_ios.sh now fails at the vcodecd link, and the symbols are from the IV archive, not P03:
   ld64.lld: undefined _pthread_setspecific, _pthread_key_create, _strnlen
   referenced by libn2vhost.a(n2a32_core.o) and (n2vcu.o)
These appeared after the latest IV/emu changes; the SDK's usr/lib/libSystem.B.tbd exports all three (lines 1729, 3115, 3136). daemon/sdk_symbols.txt does not list them. Adding them to that file (yours) should restore the link; n2vcd_cli itself links cleanly for arm64-ios16.0 (69888 bytes, NOUNDEFS), so the P03 objects are not the problem. I did not edit your file. Full log: /tmp/n2hw-P03/ios-build.log.
No action requested beyond that; I stay available.
